captions.1: 4 years later, the last of the aliens were finally defeated. Though the zombie virus they created is still spreading, as we have not yet found a cure. Those infected with the virus have remained in stasis until a cure is found.
captions.2: The aliens have returned without warning, it's still not clear why... Being the last survivor of the Raze task force, we're pulling you out of stasis early. You're still infected with the zombie virus, but lets hope you can get the job done before it takes over...
captions.4: It's time to start preparing yourself! Make sure to visit the Upgrades (or Armory) menu periodically to purchase new weapons, abilities, and equipment using the credits you've earned in battle.
captions.5: From what we know, it seems like the artifacts can generate a force field large enough to cover the entire planet. Though to do this, the 4 artifacts will need to be spread out across different parts of the Earth.
captions.6: "It was about a week ago, I was taking my Echo-1 ship on a routine trip to the space station to deliver these robots. The alien ship just sort of... Came out of no where.
captions.7: Humans have been spotted, we must destroy them at once. We can't risk our artifacts falling into their hands!
captions.8: "They attacked without warning or reason. I managed to take out their ship, but mine took too much damage and crash landed on a nearby unknown planet."
captions.9: "Despite all the damage and chaos that happened around them, they were completely unharmed, as if they posessed some sort of powerful force field. I couldn't fit them in my escape pod, so I hid them on our ship. We must retrieve them and research their power."
captions.10: "After defeating the alien survivors, I found something among all the wreckage. A bright radient glow coming from inside the destroyed alien ship. On closer inspection, it was some sort of artifact... A group of them."
captions.11: "Hey you okay? I heard they pulled you out of stasis while still infected with the Zombie virus..."
captions.12: After endless days of research, we've finally discovered the true potential of the artifacts, and the reason the aliens crave them...
captions.13: 9 years ago in 2108, earth was invaded by aliens. An elite group of soldiers was created for the sole purpose of eradicating the aliens. These soldiers were the best of the best. Unparalleled in skill and strategy. The codename for this elite task force, was Raze.
captions.14: We've discovered that the 4 artifacts that were recovered off the alien spaceship, are actually extremely powerful force field generators. When linked together, both the power and size of their forcefield grows exponentially. We're sending the artifacts to the research outposts up north for further testing.
captions.16: The location for the first artifact, is in the mines of South Africa.
captions.17: A very large meteor shower has been detected and is heading towards earth. The size and density of the shower is sure to wipe out anything in it's path. This must be why the aliens are fighting for these artifacts... Their planet must be in danger as well.
captions.18: The final artifact could not be placed in time and earth was hit by a barrage of meteors. Within just a few short days, all humanity was lost.
captions.19: With the final artifact placed, the shields were able to go up just in time, and fully withstand the impact of the meteors, as well as obsorb their force.
captions.20: Although we initially planned on giving the artifacts back to the aliens... Their value is now much too high, as they are our only chance of survival. We must fight to keep them within our posession. Even if it means war, even if it means the extinction of the alien race... We must survive.
captions.21: "All artifacts are now deployed and ready! Let's hope this works..."
captions.22: The artifacts proved to create a shield powerful enough to defend earth from destruction.
captions.22a: The artifacts proved to create a shield powerful enough to defend earth from destruction.
captions.22b: it appeared that there was indeed hope left for humanity.
captions.22d: Congratulations! You have completed the Human Campaign and saved the Human Race. Now play the Alien campaign and fight to destroy it!
captions.23: Second artifact secured, only two remain.
captions.24: Third artifact placed and ready, just one more...
captions.25: "We made it, the final artifact has been placed!"
captions.26: The second artifact has already been placed by our researchers but is under attack. We need to head over there and secure it.
captions.27: The third artifact should be placed near our research outpost in the arctic.
captions.28: The final artifact seems to be weaker than the others, as it's the only one that took some damage in the ship crashes. We believe that we'll be able to amplify it's power if placed within our testing dome. Be quick, the meteors are quickly approaching.
captions.29: First we're going to launch a TZ108-Warhead at the city. We will attack immediately after it hits. We need to wipe out as much resistance as possible by destroying their combat headquarters.
captions.30: The last thing we want is to run into the soldiers they called 'Raze'... Out of all the battles our race has ever fought, the 'Raze' soldiers are the only we've ever come to fear...
captions.31: We've destroyed their ship but have taken quite a bit of damage ourselves. They're landing on a nearby planet, follow them and wipe out any survivors!
captions.32: The humans were killed and the artifact was activated. Earth was saved. We were successful.
captions.33: By the time the first artifact was placed, we were already too late, our planet was doomed. So we devised a new plan, to secretly inhabit earth with as much of our race as possible.
captions.34: All the battles we fought were not real battles at all. They were distractions. We had actually planned on allowing the humans to place the final artifacts and save their planet.
captions.36: Over 45% of our planet was able to transfer to earth undetected during all the chaos. It may take some time, but soon...
captions.37: We could not complete the mission. The artifact was placed and activated, but we still have three more to stop!
captions.38: Mission failure, the humans placed and activated the artifact... Two more, we must stop them!
captions.39: Their forces are too strong, the third artifact was placed and activated...
captions.40: We were unable to kill the human, he has taken an escape pod back to earth. We must find those artifacts in the ship wreckage.
captions.42: The "Frozen Death" has been aquired. It seems to only work in strict areas... This will be useful in our next mission.
